ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the childcare system to uncover fraud schemes and shell companies
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to identify fake daycare centers and shell companies
questions: What are the most common schemes used by fraudsters?
ideas.insight: I believe that following the money trail will lead to uncovering a large network of fake daycare centers and shell companies. This investigation could have significant implications for the childcare system and government funding.
